headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of June 17, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 14.67% compared to SPY's 9.35%. This results in an average alpha of 5.32%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a remarkable return of 28.63%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', returned 7.91%, which is still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
